title: 第9章 绝世剑修第10章 收徒
slug: 杂役都是仙帝你管这叫没落宗门
lines: 通常来说只有王境强者才能御空飞行，但林玄不一样，他虽不是王境，但体内磅礴的灵力丝毫不逊色真正的王境强者。
且，已经成功领悟了二十一条大道，除了境界没到王境以外，林玄和寻常王境强者已经没有任何区别，甚至更有过之。
如今的林玄，可谓是缺钱缺的紧啊！
苏怜心和王焱，并不知道林玄带他们下飞舟后的目的，不过二人也没多问，但在看到林玄驭空带着他们往回走时，心中突然想到了什么。
“不会吧……师尊……难道要回去找那头紫蝎妖王？”
这想法刚一出现，两人便是对视一眼，心中震动。
而随着距离此前遭遇那头紫蝎妖王的地方越来越近，二人心中的猜测，已经变为肯定。
师尊！还真是冲那头紫蝎妖王去的！
两人小心脏扑通扑通的，那可不是什么寻常妖兽，而是一头……货真价实的妖王啊！
他们是知道师尊的境界，并非外界所认为的劫境七重，而是劫境九重，但……
哪怕是劫境九重，在妖王面前，也不过是蝼蚁啊！
他们知道师尊很是神秘，但……
带着些许担忧，王焱和苏怜心二人跟随着林玄，再一次回到了遭遇紫蝎妖王的地方。
才一到，林玄便是一剑劈向那不远处的大地。
可怕的剑罡，将大地劈出一道深深的沟渠，紧接着，一声怒吼自地底传来，一头数十丈高的庞大紫蝎，破地而出，愤怒的盯着三人，准确的说是盯着林玄。
“人类，此前饶你一次，你当真以为本王怕你不成！？”
紫蝎妖王口吐人言，声音中带着一抹难以抑制的怒意。
而紫蝎妖王的这一句话，却是让得林玄身后的苏怜心和王焱一惊……
他们听到了什么？
此前饶你一次，你当真以为本王怕你不成？
忽然想到了什么，王焱和苏怜心眼中，都是显露出无穷震惊。
其实此前第一次遭遇这头紫蝎妖王时，两人也以为是清微峰主震慑住了这头紫蝎妖王，让其退走的。
但听着紫蝎妖王愤怒的言语，似乎……并非这么一回事？
那紫蝎妖王忌惮的，不是清微峰主，真正怕的，是师尊？
原来如此！原来是这样！
“你怕我，你当然怕我，你若是不怕我，你直接就动手了，而不是在这里跟我废什么话。”林玄笑着说道。
“人类，你找死！”
紫蝎妖王腾空而起，尾部那根长长的尖刺，直接是脱离了本体，朝着林玄爆射而来。
而紫蝎妖王在轰出这一击的同时，也不犹豫，直接往反方向极速逃掠而去。
这一幕，更是让王焱和苏怜心两人惊掉了下巴。
他们还以为接下来免不了一场大战，结果却是……紫蝎妖王在轰出一道尖刺过后，直接选择逃了？
极速逃离的紫蝎妖王并不知道王焱苏怜心二人心中的想法，他只知道，自己绝非林玄的对手。
他活了那么多年，谁能惹得起，谁惹不起，他只一眼便能判断出来。
林玄这个人类太过诡异，明明只有劫境九重，但却给紫蝎妖王带来极大的压迫之意，那眼神中的骇人剑意，哪怕只是看上一眼，便足以让它心慌神惧。
面对那袭来的尖刺，林玄纹丝不动，眼眸中一道剑光闪过，虚空之中便是劈出一道剑气，直接将尖刺斩落。
然后，抬手，轻轻一点虚空。
紧接着，紫蝎妖王所逃窜的路径之上，一道冰霜巨剑自地底劈出，瞬间刺穿了紫蝎妖

冰剑……
林玄领悟的剑系大道之一，原本林玄还以为这一剑，不足以将紫蝎妖王击杀，却不想，倒是他小瞧了此剑的威力，也低估了自己如今的实力。
王境一重的紫蝎妖王，陨！
连林玄一剑都没接下。
content_en:
Generally speaking, only king-level experts can fly in the air, but Lin Xuan is different. Although he is not a king-level expert, the majestic spiritual power in his body is not inferior to that of a true king-level expert.
Moreover, he has successfully understood the twenty-one avenues. Except that his realm has not reached the king realm, Lin Xuan is no different from ordinary king realm experts, or even worse.
Today, Lin Xuan is really short of money!
Su Lianxin and Wang Yan didn't know Lin Xuan's purpose after taking them off the flying boat, but they didn't ask much. But when they saw Lin Xuan taking them back in the air, they suddenly thought of something.
"No way...Master...are you going to go back to find the purple scorpion demon king?"
As soon as this idea appeared, the two of them looked at each other, and their hearts were shocked.
And as they got closer and closer to the place where they had encountered the purple scorpion demon king, their suspicions had become certain.
Master! He really went for the purple scorpion demon king!
The hearts of the two of them were pounding. That was not an ordinary monster, but a... real monster king!
They know that the master's realm is not the seventh level of the tribulation realm as the outside world thinks, but the ninth level of the tribulation realm, but...
Even if he is at the ninth level of the Tribulation Realm, he is nothing but an ant in front of the Demon King!
They know that Master is very mysterious, but...
With some worries, Wang Yan and Su Lianxin followed Lin Xuan and returned to the place where they encountered the Purple Scorpion Demon King.
"Boom——!"
As soon as he arrived, Lin Xuan struck the ground not far away with a sword.
The terrifying sword gang cut a deep trench into the earth. Then, a roar came from the ground. A huge purple scorpion with a height of tens of feet broke out of the ground and stared at the three people angrily. To be precise, it stared at Lin Xuan.
"Human, let me spare you once before. Do you really think that this king is afraid of you!?"
The Purple Scorpion Demon King spoke human words, with a touch of uncontrollable anger in his voice.
But these words of the Purple Scorpion Demon King shocked Su Lianxin and Wang Yan behind Lin Xuan...
What did they hear?
I spared you once before. Do you really think that this king is afraid of you?
This...
Suddenly thinking of something, Wang Yan and Su Lianxin's eyes showed infinite shock.
In fact, when they first encountered the Purple Scorpion Demon King, the two of them thought that Peak Master Qingwei had frightened the Purple Scorpion Demon King and made him retreat.
But listening to the angry words of the Purple Scorpion Demon King, it seems...that's not the case?
What the Purple Scorpion Demon King is afraid of is not Peak Master Qingwei. What he is really afraid of is the Master?
I see! So that’s it!
"You are afraid of me, of course you are afraid of me. If you were not afraid of me, you would just take action instead of talking nonsense to me here." Lin Xuan said with a smile.
"Human, you are seeking death!"
The Purple Scorpion Demon King soared into the air, and the long spike on its tail separated from its body and shot towards Lin Xuan.
When the Purple Scorpion Demon King launched this attack, he did not hesitate and fled in the opposite direction at high speed.
This scene made Wang Yan and Su Lianxin even more shocked.
They thought that a big battle was inevitable next, but the result was... the Purple Scorpion Demon King directly chose to escape after blasting out a spike?
The Purple Scorpion Demon King, who fled as fast as he could, didn't know what Wang Yan and Su Lianxin were thinking. He only knew that he was no match for Lin Xuan.
He had lived for so many years, and he could tell who he could afford to offend and who he couldn't afford to offend with just one look.
Lin Xuan, a human being, was too weird. He was only at the ninth level of the Tribulation Realm, but he brought great oppression to the Purple Scorpion Demon King. The terrifying sword intent in his eyes was enough to make him panic and frightened even just by looking at him.
"Cang!"
Facing the incoming sharp thorn, Lin Xuan remained motionless. A sword light flashed in his eyes, and a sword energy split out of the void, directly cutting off the sharp thorn.
Then, raise your hand and touch the void lightly.
Immediately afterwards, on the path where the Purple Scorpion Demon King fled, a giant frost sword came out from the ground and instantly pierced the Purple Scorpion Demon King.

Ice sword...
Lin Xuan understood one of the great ways of the sword system. Originally, Lin Xuan thought that this sword was not enough to kill the Purple Scorpion Demon King, but unexpectedly, he underestimated the power of this sword and underestimated his current strength.
The Purple Scorpion Demon King, who was at the first level of the King Realm, died!
He didn't even take Lin Xuan's sword.
